limitations: Constructor inference covers direct native Component primary constructors with one non-implicit parameter list and plain arguments; val/var accessors, secondary/multiple lists and indirect inheritance use explicit body declarations.
Optional constructor formals support Option[Param[Int]] with absent zero and explicit presence forwarding. Other optional policies retain existing body APIs.
Direct scoped Bits reads retain existing ownership/domain and procedural-process limits; this does not infer arbitrary Scala or procedural loops.
Concrete partial child inputs require exact unconditional full coverage and proved partial widths. Symbolic partial bindings without that proof remain rejected.
Existing Vec.reduceBalancedTree topology and library BalancedTree bridge/order contracts are unchanged.
Questa is unavailable locally. Application integration parses approved unchanged Dan IP as Verilog-2005 for $clog2; generated RTL remains parsed as Verilog-2001.
This is focused local acceptance, not full CI, whole-branch qualification, formal coverage of all APIs, or customer acceptance.
